title: Derived payload models
summary: The payload models lm-derive writes from the FHIR logical models: a JSON-LD context, SHACL shapes and CDDL rules (models/generated/). Never edited by hand.
validatorNotApplicable: derived wholly from models/fhir by lm-derive, whose --check fails when a file is stale; check-models checks the SHACL shapes against the SHACL shapes for SHACL (pyshacl's meta-SHACL) and validates the PR 129 payload against all three, reading it as RDF through the JSON-LD context.
